AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.title: Diurganate Beliver
AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] is a follower of the Divine Diurganate. Followers are the cornerstone of the Divine Diurganate; regardless of their motives or past, the Church accepts all Ratkins and treats them with equal care. The Ratkin Nuns of the Church taught [PAWN_pronoun] basic survival skills, enabling [PAWN_pronoun] to use them to survive in this dangerous, precarious world.

AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.title: Diurganate Sister
AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] is a nun from the Divine Diurganate. Compared to the followers of various folk religions in the Ratkin Kingdom, the followers of the Diurganate are more radical, thus [PAWN_pronoun] is different from the nuns active in other Rat Kingdoms. As the leader of the Diurganate's small group of followers, [PAWN_pronoun] always inspires nearby followers with her passionate spirit and leads them in striving for common goals—whether it's building colonies, holding prayer gatherings, or judging the unbelievers.

AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.title: Diurganate Pastor
AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] is a Pastor of the Divine Diurganate. Unlike Nuns, Pastor do not directly interact with believers. Instead, they are responsible for maintaining and consecrating the Diurganate's massive mechanical creations, regularly praying for them, changing incense, and applying holy grease. However, [PAWN_nameDef] made a mistake during a consecration. [PAWN_pronoun] applied too much holy grease to the leg joints of a mech without using an incense burner. This non-dogmatic consecration caused the mech to slip in the hangar, crushing several Ratkins. As a result, [PAWN_pronoun] was exiled by the Diurganate.

AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.title: Diurganate Pilot
AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] is a pilot for the Divine Diurganate. The pilot mice undergo systematic training within the Diurganate to pilot its mechs. The mechs are filled with billowing black smoke and unbearably high temperatures, but compared to their counterparts who crawl through tunnels, [PAWN_pronoun]'s situation is much better. However, [PAWN_nameDef]'s past is not honorable. During a battle, [PAWN_possessive] mech was pierced by an armor-piercing round. When the brains and tissues of the other mice inside splattered on [PAWN_pronoun], [PAWN_nameDef] screamed and abandoned mech, becoming a deserter.

AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.title: Diurganate Zealot
AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] is the most fanatical follower of the Divine Diurganate. [PAWN_possessive] always practices the doctrines in [PAWN_possessive] actions, taking it upon to expel all heretics. This fanatical mad Ratkin is a problem for the church, so the church made up a reason and sent [PAWN_possessive] to this unfamiliar land.
